analysis.regime_rationale: NEUTRAL (0.4 confidence): BTC dropped below $80K on Iran geopolitical shock — $300M in futures liquidations, negative funding rates, and options flow rotating to protective puts. Fear & Greed still cautious. However, long-term trend remains up ($63K→$80K over 3 months), Tom Lee confirms bull market if May closes above $76K (BTC currently well above), and three signals still point to $85K. Mixed picture: short-term bearish pressure vs. intact macro uptrend. Confidence 0.4 (below 0.5 bot filter) — bot should not filter on regime this cycle.
